label: 3 NOV · 0.5
title: Meet Ridgeline.
body: A new progression line on the alpine ridge. Warm up in two rail zones, link five flow kickers from First Tracks to Home Stretch, then branch off to the Side Quest hip. Wider takeoffs and a smaller opening jump make room to find your rhythm. Ride solo or join a live room; complete runs count toward your goals, journal and session records.

label: 3 NOV · 0.5
title: Stay connected to your mountain.
body: Sign-in now supports a separately hosted account server. Email addresses are trimmed before sign-in and registration, connection problems have clearer explanations, and Basecamp includes a server status check with a retry button. Progress stays with your account when the permanent database is connected.

label: 3 NOV · 0.5
title: Find your next session faster.
body: Jump into Ridgeline from the park selector or the new Basecamp shortcut. The journal now has a sixth scored park stamp. Direct links to goals, sessions, updates, recovery and the journal work in the static build, so you can bookmark them and come back later.

label: 3 NOV · 0.4
title: Eight new reasons to drop in
body: Ranked 3v3 and 4v4 join 1v1 and 2v2 in the red ranked selector above Find Match. Riding solo? Chase Time Attack, Score Rush, Clean Line, Park Tour, Air Time and Rail Jam from Ride’s Solo Sessions button. Six solo challenges, two bigger ranked formats, one familiar Basecamp.
alt: Mountain Sessions: six solo modes and ranked squads, illustrated with alpine peaks and trail lines.

label: 3 NOV · 0.4
title: Bring the whole crew
body: Queue for 3v3 or 4v4 alone or with a party. Parties stay together and every rider confirms readiness before the match starts. Everyone rides one solo Apex run in the same six-minute window; verified scores combine into the team total. Each format has its own rating and leaderboard, with rating protection for a losing teammate who stayed when another rider left.

label: 3 NOV · 0.4
title: Every lap leaves a mark
body: Your Mountain journal remembers your verified finishes, personal bests, favourite park and days on snow. Finish a run in each of the five scored parks to stamp your passport. Six lifetime milestones award a total of 675 POW, from your first tracks to the Century Club. Previous verified runs count too.

label: 3 NOV · 0.4
title: Your kit. Your week. Your mountain.
body: Save three named outfits in the Locker and swap complete setups. Restored 180 missing equipment textures, refreshed cached rider pictures and fixed saved-outfit broadcasts to mountain riders and parties. Three weekly goals award up to 300 POW for 20 finishes, all five parks and riding on three different UTC days. Weekly goals reset Monday at 00:00 UTC.

label: 3 NOV · 0.4
title: Your next line has something to beat
body: Every session saves its result. Check your best for each mode and park, browse your latest twenty attempts, or see the top twenty-five riders on the session boards. The in-game session display tracks your progress, and the Park Tour keeps your next stop ready across visits. A daily park pick gives you somewhere new to start.

label: 3 NOV · 0.3
title: Small goals. More reasons to ride.
body: Finish three runs, score 5,000 points and explore two parks to earn up to 100 POW a day. Claim your rewards in Menu → Daily + weekly goals. Goals reset at midnight UTC and only completed verified runs count. Cash purchases remain closed.
